# App shell (`app-shell`)

Title bar with actions and the app frame.

Group: Layout & shells. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/layout';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createAppShell` (types in `dist/web/layout/appShell.d.ts`): `.mh-app-shell` (`--nav-start | --nav-bottom | --nav-auto`, `--fixed`): the app frame. A `header` title bar (`__bar` with `__leading`, `__titles` holding the `h1` `__title` and `__subtitle`, and `__actions`), a `__body` with the `__nav` slot and the scrolling `__content` (a `.mh-screen` column without its own canvas), and a `__status` slot. Safe areas are padded on every edge.

```ts
export function createAppShell(options: AppShellOptions, ...children: Child[]): AppShellHandle;

export interface AppShellOptions {
  /** The app or page title in the title bar (an `h1`). */
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  /** Before the title: a back or menu button. */
  leading?: HTMLElement;
  /** At the end of the title bar: icon buttons, an avatar. */
  actions?: HTMLElement[];
  /** The navigation slot: a nav rail, a tab bar, a list of links. Wrap it in your own `nav` landmark. */
  nav?: HTMLElement;
  /** Default `auto`. */
  navPosition?: AppShellNav;
  /** Below everything: a status bar. */
  status?: HTMLElement;
  /** Width of the content column (default `wide`). */
  width?: ScreenWidth;
  /** Accessible name of the main region. */
  label?: string;
  /** The canvas backdrop behind the frame (default true). */
  canvas?: boolean;
  /** The title bar stays at the top while the content scrolls under it (default true). */
  fixed?: boolean;
}

export interface AppShellHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** The `main` region to append content to. */
  main: HTMLElement;
  /** The scrolling content area. */
  content: HTMLDivElement;
  setTitle(title: string): void;
  setSubtitle(subtitle: string): void;
}
```

`createCard` (types in `dist/web/data-display/card.d.ts`): `.mh-card`: a surface with `--mh-surface`, the panel outline, `--mh-radius-lg` and `--mh-shadow-1`. Parts `__media`, `__header` (`__icon`, `__heading` with `__eyebrow`, `__title`, `__subtitle`; `__action`), `__body`, `__footer`. Variants `--flat`, `--inset`; `--interactive` when the whole card is pressable, as a `role="button"` or, with `href`, as an `<a>`.

```ts
export function createCard(options: CardOptions = {}): CardHandle;

export interface CardOptions {
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  /** A small line above the title ("Source · 2 h ago"). */
  eyebrow?: string;
  /** Clamps the title to this many lines. */
  titleLines?: ClampLines;
  /** Small icon before the title. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** An element at the end of the header (an icon button, a badge, a switch). */
  headerAction?: HTMLElement;
  /** Edge-to-edge media at the top (an `<img>`), shown 16:9 and cropped to cover. */
  media?: HTMLElement;
  /** Width / height of the media (default 16 / 9); a wider one (2 or 2.4) keeps pictures short in a list or carousel. */
  mediaAspect?: number;
  /** Body content. */
  body?: Child | Child[];
  /** Footer content (usually buttons). */
  footer?: Child | Child[];
  /** `raised` (default) lifts off the canvas with `--mh-shadow-1`; `flat` has no shadow; `inset` sits in a well. */
  variant?: CardVariant;
  /** The whole card is one link (`<a href>`). Don't put other links or buttons inside. */
  href?: string;
  /** Link target; `_blank` also sets `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. */
  target?: string;
  /** The whole card is one pressable target (`role="button"`, Enter and Space); with `href`, a click listener on the link. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent | KeyboardEvent) => void;
  /** Accessible name of a pressable card (default: its text). */
  label?: string;
  /** Heading level of the title (default 3). */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
}

export interface CardHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** The body element, to append content later. */
  body: HTMLDivElement;
  setTitle(title: string): void;
  setSubtitle(subtitle: string): void;
}
```

`createIconButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/iconButton.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-button`: a round, icon-only button at least a touch target wide.

```ts
export function createIconButton(options: IconButtonOptions): IconButtonHandle;

export interface IconButtonOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the button's accessible name (also its tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  /** A filled circle (raised surface) rather than a bare glyph. */
  filled?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createStatusBar` (types in `dist/web/layout/statusBar.d.ts`): `.mh-status-bar` (`--sticky`): a slim `footer` bar of status items in a `__start` and an `__end` group. Each `__item` (`--accent | --success | --warning | --danger`, `--interactive` when it is a button) has an `__icon`, a `__label` and a mono `__value`.

```ts
export function createStatusBar(options: StatusBarOptions): StatusBarHandle;

export interface StatusBarOptions {
  /** Accessible name (default "Status"). */
  label?: string;
  items: readonly StatusBarItem[];
  /** Pins the bar to the bottom of a positioned container (default: in flow). */
  sticky?: boolean;
}

export interface StatusBarHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** Changes one item in place (label, value, icon, tone, title). */
  setItem(id: string, patch: Partial<Omit<StatusBarItem, 'id' | 'end' | 'onClick' | 'announce'>>): void;
}

export interface StatusBarItem {
  id: string;
  /** Visible text ("Connected", "3 updates"). */
  label: string;
  /** A value after the label, in the mono face ("21.5°", "14:02"). */
  value?: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  tone?: StatusBarTone;
  /** A fuller description, as a tooltip and the accessible description. */
  title?: string;
  /** Sits at the far end of the bar. */
  end?: boolean;
  /** Screen readers hear changes to this item (`aria-live="polite"`). */
  announce?: boolean;
  /** The item becomes a button. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createAppShell, createCard, createIconButton, createStatusBar, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const sections = [
  { label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
  { label: 'Lights', icon: 'lightbulb' },
  { label: 'Climate', icon: 'thermometer' },
];
const nav = h('nav', { 'aria-label': 'Sections' });

const shell = createAppShell(
  {
    title: 'Home',
    subtitle: 'Living room',
    actions: [createIconButton({ icon: 'search', label: 'Search' }).el],
    nav,
    navPosition: 'auto',
    status: createStatusBar({ items: [{ id: 'net', label: 'Connected', icon: 'wifi', tone: 'success' }] }).el,
  },
  createCard({ title: 'Climate', body: '21.5° and 46% humidity.' }).el,
  createCard({ title: 'Lights', body: 'Kitchen light and 2 others are on.' }).el,
);

const tabs = sections.map(({ label, icon }, i) =>
  createIconButton({
    icon,
    label,
    pressed: i === 0,
    onClick: () => {
      tabs.forEach((tab, j) => tab.setPressed(j === i));
      shell.setTitle(label);
    },
  }),
);
nav.append(...tabs.map((tab) => tab.el));

document.body.append(shell.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { AppShell, Card, IconButton, StatusBar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const SECTIONS = [
  { label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
  { label: 'Lights', icon: 'lightbulb' },
  { label: 'Climate', icon: 'thermometer' },
];

export function AppShellExample() {
  const [section, setSection] = useState('Home');
  const nav = (
    <nav aria-label="Sections">
      {SECTIONS.map(({ label, icon }) => (
        <IconButton key={label} icon={icon} label={label} pressed={label === section} onClick={() => setSection(label)} />
      ))}
    </nav>
  );
  return (
    <AppShell
      title={section}
      subtitle="Living room"
      actions={<IconButton icon="search" label="Search" />}
      nav={nav}
      navPosition="auto"
      status={<StatusBar items={[{ id: 'net', label: 'Connected', icon: 'wifi', tone: 'success' }]} />}
    >
      <Card title="Climate">21.5° and 46% humidity.</Card>
      <Card title="Lights">Kitchen light and 2 others are on.</Card>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```
